title: Mailbox/set args
description: Arguments for Mailbox/set (RFC 8621 §3.5). Creates, updates, or destroys Mailbox objects.

accountId.description: The account to apply changes to.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. The call fails with stateMismatch if the Mailbox state differs.

create.description: Map of client-assigned creation ids to Mailbox objects to create.

update.description: Map of MailboxId to PatchObject. Only explicitly listed properties are changed.

onDestroyRemoveEmails.description: If true, also destroy all emails in the mailbox. Default false; destroying a non-empty mailbox without this flag results in a mailboxHasChild or mailboxHasEmail error.
